chapter: Ellington colleagues, singers and world tours
title: Special policeman and the plan to be a T-man
summary: He was a special officer around 1929 and considered becoming a treasury agent.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: And it says here, "Used to be a policeman in Los Angeles." Were you a policeman in Los Angeles?
I was a special for about a year in Los Angeles around 1929. I had my eye set on a government agent,
but it didn't work out so well, so I had to give that side up for the music side.
You mean in 1929 you considered doing something else professionally?

Oh, yes. Yes, I was going to be a T-man, treasury agent, and I knew one-- and he came out here, and we talked, discussed the possibilities, and so I said, "Well, I'd like to do that." But I soon gave that up.
